frozen_body: W02 distinguishes the standard twistor construction, where a point is a right-handed C2 subspace of C4 and left-handed spinors are the quotient, from its stronger proposal that the tangent bundle itself be chirally asymmetric and purely right-handed.
semantic_guards: The standard construction uses exact quotient semantics T/S and does not choose a complement.
The tangent-Hom family uses the W047 frozen axiomatic bundle boundary.
The right-handed proposal uses the already exact W131 carrier/action and does not infer a left action.
The contrast relation is extensional source metadata only; it does not assert a mathematical isomorphism between the two tangent descriptions.
No electroweak/internal interpretation and no Lisi semantics are added.
